rank5Prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: RANK 5 FINAL IMAGE of a five-stage evolving-world iPhone lofi focus app, one full-bleed tall portrait about 9:19.5.
Input image is STYLE ONLY: match its atmospheric subdued pixel-painted art, irregular pixel clusters, stepped contours and lost edges, deep blue-violet nighttime shadows, small warm amber window lights and quiet lived-in textures. Do not copy its cat, pharmacy or layout. Not children's-book watercolor, clean anime, 3D miniature, isometric game render or toy diorama.
CORE CONCEPT: A SMALL SPIRAL SEASHELL HAS PHYSICALLY GROWN AND TRANSFORMED INTO A SELF-CONTAINED COASTAL WORLD. This is not a town pasted onto a shell and not a giant shell used as a bowl prop. The shell's material has become pale weathered limestone, the spiraling whorls are TERRACED HILLSIDES, its aperture has expanded into a sheltered real WATER INLET open to the surrounding sea. The original tapering spiral peak remains legible at rear-left as a modest rocky hill; the broad curved lip at front-right has become a rugged coastline. Preserve unmistakable seashell ancestry in overall silhouette, ridged stone strata and spiral geography, but most visible surface is now believable land, vegetation and lived-in town. No perfect glossy intact shell surrounding toy buildings.
CAMERA: elevated three-quarter view looking down about35degrees from front, full whole island visible, spiral hill at rear LEFT, inlet opening faces lower RIGHT. Entire evolved world centered and occupying about75% picture width and65% height, lowest edge above bottom10%, rear hill around upper25%. Dark calm ocean surrounds all edges; thin distant horizon in upper quarter and quiet deep navy sky. No external continents/cities distracting from the one world. Strong depth, no sterile studio pedestal.
RANK5 SCENE: richly developed intimate Japanese-influenced harbor town on the terraced spiral hill wrapping around a curved sheltered bay. Small weathered plaster houses, dark tiled roofs, balconies with plants, narrow switchback stairs following whorl grooves, a modest workshop with warm windows and a small rotating-fan-ready opening, one little stone bridge spanning an internal narrow watercourse, a tiny waterside square, wood docks and2-3 tiny moored boats. Hilltop small lighthouse grows from original shell tip, warm lamp glow, not grand tower. Tree clusters and shrubs root between limestone ledges, a little spring stream descends through hillside and empties into bay. Soft chimney smoke, a little cloth on balcony, warm windows reflected in quiet blue inner sea. No close-up people, if any tiny distant silhouettes only, no focal cat. Balanced rich environment, varied readable shapes and restful water/sky, not a cluttered dense city. Not medieval castle, wizard village or steampunk.
LOFI MOOD: late evening deep indigo/charcoal-violet with subtle muted teal water, amber lamps and dim dusty rose shell-limestone highlights. Night palette carried by shadows, no saturated purple sunset or all-orange sepia wash. Quiet wistful warm place to live, gently fantastical morphology but familiar real neighborhood details. Clear animation-friendly elements: small boats/water reflections, slow lighthouse glow, wisps of chimney steam, fan, foliage and cloth, no spectacle or particle swarm.
No text/rank numerals/labels/UI/phone statusbar, borders/watermarks, collage, diagram, exposed cross-section or cutaway. One finished rank5 still image.
